newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea business body urges fast financial reform.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea business body urges fast financial reform.

text.p: The Federation of Korean Industries urged the government to accelerate implementation of financial reforms in South Korea, a federation statement said on Friday.
The statement said reforms would ease the pressures on corporations that have had trouble securing financing because of the wave of debt defaults by big companies.

The federation, which represents major South Korean corporations, said government deregulation efforts have fallen short of expectations. Unnecessary regulations related to corporate financing should be improved or scrapped, it said.
